title: Ordinary scalar evaluation respects coefficient squares
statement: Let E_a be normalized ordinary additive scalar extensions with adjunctions and generator-normalized strong chain tensor comparisons [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data]. Let B be a strict presentation of this family and h_b be any scalar chain evaluation with formula (s tensor x) tensor p -> s tensor b(x)(p) [lem-sfb-ordinary-scalar-evaluation-model]. For a commuting coefficient square R -> S, R -> Rprime, S -> Sprime, Rprime -> Sprime, let Q be a compatible strict coefficient square for B [lem-sfb-hom-scalar-chain-identification]. Then scalar evaluation after the tensor comparison, strict tensor base change and extended Hom comparison equals extension of scalar evaluation followed by the restriction mate and extension isomorphism of Q. The equality holds for arbitrary complexes D,P,I and chain maps b:D -> Hom(P,I), with no derived-category or flatness assumptions.

proof.text: Cancel the presentation isomorphism at the source and transpose by the ordinary scalar adjunction. Sheafified tensor generation reduces the equality to every section (s tensor x) tensor p.

On the first route use the normalized tensor comparison, inverse presentation formula, tensor-square compatibility, scalar evaluation formula and evaluation of the extended Hom comparison. Its value is d(s) tensor (1 tensor b(x)(p)).

On the second route use naturality of scalar-unit sections, scalar evaluation, inverse presentation, restriction mate and extension-square pure formulas. The same value results. The generator test and injectivity of adjunction transposition prove the chain equality.

theorem coefficient_square (O : Scalars.{c, v, r} (J := J))
    (μ : ∀ {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r}} (a : R ⟶ S), Tensor O a)
    (E : Evaluation.{c, v, r} (J := J) O) (B : Presentation.{c, v, r} (J := J) O)
    {R S R' S' : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r}}
    (φ : R ⟶ S) (a : R ⟶ R') (d : S ⟶ S') (φ' : R' ⟶ S')
    (Q : StrictScalarHom.CoefficientSquare.{c, v, r}
      (B.chainData φ) (B.chainData a) (B.chainData d) (B.chainData φ'))
    (hQ : StrictScalarHom.CoefficientCompatibility.{c, v, r} Q)
    (P I D : StrictScalarHom.Complex.{c, v, r} R) (b : D ⟶ homComplex (R := R) P I) :
      (B.chainIso a).hom.app ((coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj
          ((StrictScalarHom.tensor.{c, v, r} φ).obj D, P)) ≫
        ((μ a).complexIso ((StrictScalarHom.tensor.{c, v, r} φ).obj D) P).hom ≫
        (coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R').map
          (Prod.mkHom ((B.chainIso a).inv.app ((StrictScalarHom.tensor.{c, v, r} φ).obj D))
            ((B.chainIso a).inv.app P)) ≫
        (coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R').map
          (Prod.mkHom (Q.tensorComparison D) (𝟙 ((B.chainData a).extension.complex.obj P))) ≫
        E.scalarEvaluate φ' ((B.chainData a).extension.complex.obj P)
          ((B.chainData a).extension.complex.obj I) ((B.chainData a).extension.complex.obj D)
          ((B.chainData a).extension.complex.map b ≫ (B.chainData a).homComparison P I) ≫
        (StrictScalarHom.restriction.{c, v, r} φ').map
          ((B.chainIso φ').inv.app ((B.chainData a).extension.complex.obj I)) =
      (B.chainData a).extension.complex.map
          (E.scalarEvaluate φ P I D b ≫
            (StrictScalarHom.restriction.{c, v, r} φ).map ((B.chainIso φ).inv.app I)) ≫
        Q.restrictionMate.app ((B.chainData φ).extension.complex.obj I) ≫
        (StrictScalarHom.restriction.{c, v, r} φ').map (Q.extensionIso.hom.app I)
